[[File:Warped terrorbird icon.png|left]]
The '''warped terrorbird''' is a [[Slayer]] monster found in the [[Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon]]. They require 56 Slayer and a [[Crystal chime]] to be killed. There are also three level 82 warped terrorbirds that the player must fight near the end of [[The Path of Glouphrie]] quest; see [[The Path of Glouphrie#Warped|here]] for a guide to that fight. Players must have at least started the quest in order to receive these monsters as a Slayer assignment.

Warped terrorbirds are also capable of attacking with ranged and hit higher than their melee attacks, so it is recommended to use [[Protect from Missiles]] or equivalents when fighting them. Wearing [[earmuffs]], [[masked earmuffs]] or any version of the [[slayer helmet]] (including on the [[slayer helmet stand]]) will also greatly reduce the amount of damage dealt by this attack.

Players may travel there by:
*Using [[Spirit Tree]] to [[Poison Waste]].
*Going west of [[Castle Wars]] with a [[Crossbow]] and a [[Mithril grapple]] equipped to grapple across the river.

Enter through the sewer entrance south-west of the [[Spirit tree]].

*Additionally, players who have completed the [[Tirannwn Set Tasks - Medium]] can use the [[Tirannwn quiver 2]] teleport to the [[Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon]] to arrive within the first room of the dungeon.

[[File:Arposandra machine.png|thumb|The Machine in [[Arposandra]] that either creates intelligent or warped terrorbirds.]]

==Update history==
{{Update history|
* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (4 November 2019)|date=4 November 2019}}
** Lessened the harshness of warped terrorbird and tortoise in the poison waste dungeon as well as toned down the chime sound a little.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (29 July 2013)|date=29 July 2013}} 
** Discontinued weapon poisons are now untradeable, and Warped Tortoises & Terrorbirds no longer drop them.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The Path of Glouphrie|date=3 September 2007}}
** Added to game.
}}
